title: Serve without making yourself the headline
summary: Service becomes pure when the self stops asking to be noticed. Serve in a way that leaves the self quieter.
takeaway: Serve in a way that leaves the self quieter.
lifeApplication: When service starts bargaining for notice, return it to hidden love and steady hands.

source.shortMeaning: Service becomes pure when the self stops asking to be noticed.
source.lifeApplication: Before displaying the good you did, let the act stay hidden.

evidence.coreClaim: Service becomes pure when the self stops asking to be noticed.
evidence.turn: Service becomes true when the self stops asking to be seen.
evidence.practicalImplication: When service starts bargaining for notice, return it to hidden love and steady hands.
